title: /research-autopilot — Startup Research Router
description: Startup research router: classifies your query (market size, competitor, pricing, ICP, GTM, regulatory), selects the right tools, shows a plan with token budget, waits for approval, then delivers a structured report. Use when you need research done — not when you want to write code.
key_design_decisions: Approval gate is hard stop — agent never executes without user confirm
Max 3 tools per run to keep token budget predictable
RAG first because it's zero-cost and project-specific
Each category has a fixed report template to make output scannable
Confidence matrix is mandatory — tells user how much to trust the output
